guide.title: VIRTUAL_AUDIO_SETUP

steps: Download VB-Cable from the official VB-Audio website and unzip it.
Right-click VBCABLE_Setup_x64.exe → Run as administrator → Install Driver. Restart your computer.
In EasyVoice → Voice Changer → LIVE, pick “CABLE Input (VB-Audio)” as Output, then press START.
In Discord / OBS / Zoom, choose “CABLE Output (VB-Audio)” as your microphone.
To hear yourself, enable “Listen to this device” for CABLE Output in Windows Sound settings.
Download BlackHole 2ch from the official Existential Audio website and run the installer.
Open EasyVoice → Voice Changer → LIVE, pick “BlackHole 2ch” as Output, then press START.
In Discord / OBS / Zoom, choose “BlackHole 2ch” as your microphone.
To hear yourself too, create a Multi-Output Device in Audio MIDI Setup with your speakers + BlackHole.

guide.note: EasyVoice does not install audio drivers itself. Links open the developers' official pages.
